scope: Independent canon audit of the retained Chapter 99 producer checkpoint evidence.

evidence_defects.finding: record_id P11-zh-Hans-CN-099-0001 occurs twice, while P11-zh-Hans-CN-099-0011 claims to supersede absent record P11-zh-Hans-CN-099-0010.
evidence_defects.impact: The producer history cannot be treated as a unique, gap-free supersession chain. The final completed record still binds the admitted target, receipt, and PDF and is independently replayed by canon.

evidence_defects.finding: The navigator has 117 entries, but the log contains 116 missing external AUX warnings and 116 undefined navigator hyper-reference warnings. The remaining entry is the current Chapter 99 self-link, so producer field undefined_external_chapter_hyperlinks=117 overstates unresolved external links by one.

The producer receipt records contact-sheet SHA-256 968351DB1FF56866398EBBB41CB8EB5B01FD4E2FF10BFAACB9952C6603719FB4 but records no path, and no contact-sheet file is present in the bounded p11/control or p11/zh_hans_cn/build/ch099 directories.
evidence_defects.impact: The historical all-page visual-review assertion is receipt-only. Canon must rely on a fresh cumulative all-page render and visual inspection before publication.

evidence_defects.finding: The final log contains three LaTeX release-version warning occurrences. They are nonfatal but were not represented in the producer zero-warning summary.

canon_disposition.basis: Authority/target identity, structural replay, PDF mechanics, and reader-facing completeness checks pass independently. The defects concern producer evidence bookkeeping, not the admitted translation bytes.
canon_disposition.publication_gate: Do not use the producer visual assertion as publication proof. Publish Chapter 99 only inside a freshly built cumulative reader after independent PDF-object checks and every-page cumulative rendering/visual QA pass.
